Author: CJ
Name: EasyIsle
Punchline: Island Sanctuary workshop planner that works from what your island actually has.
Description:
Plans your Isleworks agenda around your real island: rank, workshops, isleventory, crops, animals, granary expeditions, Supply & Demand and Felicitous Favors.

Advice only: EasyIsle never sets anything for you. Everything is read locally from the game; nothing is sent anywhere.
